description: Adds a NIfTI volume from this computer over every volume of the open dataset: a statistical map, a mask or segmentation, or an atlas, which shows with its labels when it has a label sidecar.

path.description: Absolute path to a NIfTI volume (.nii, .nii.gz) inside an allowed data root.

overlay.description: The overlay's volume id and label.

dataset.description: The dataset now open: its name, root folder, and each volume's id, label, shape and spacing, with the one shown marked.

useWhen: Show a statistical map, mask or atlas from disk over the dataset the window shows.

avoidWhen.when: Nothing is open yet, or the volume should replace what is shown.

preconditions: A dataset is open in the window.
The path is inside a folder agents may open: by default the person's home folder.
effects: Reloads the viewer with the overlay; the overlay stays across select_volume, unlike one added with add_overlay.

duration.basis: A 2 mm MNI statistical map on an Apple-silicon laptop.

failures.meaning: The window has nothing to overlay.

match.contains: outside the folders agents may open

failures.meaning: The path resolves, after following symlinks, outside the folders NeuroVue lets agents open.
failures.remedy: Ask the person to add the folder to "roots" in NeuroVue's mcp.json, or to open the file themselves. Retrying with the same path will not help.

failures.meaning: The path is relative; NeuroVue does not know which folder it is relative to.
Nothing exists at that path, or NeuroVue may not read it.
failures.remedy: Check the path; on macOS the person may need to give NeuroVue access to the folder.
